_what: The video chain is its four components, in order: video-teardown, video-writing, video-production, video-edit. Each stage is one component: the role that runs it, the component's own door (the command that switches it on), what it makes, and what a hand-off INTO it must carry, which is the previous component's output in the shape this component's door takes. Who holds a role is roles.json, not this file.

stages.name: Video teardown

activates.say: Open the hand-off {key} from {folder}. Run the video teardown on refs/swipe.mp4 for {brand}: dry run first, then the run.

stages.makes: runs/video-teardown/_work/<label>/ (stages 0, 1, 1k, 1c, 1b, 2; run.json, elements.json, framemap/, sound-sheet, transcript), filed to runs/video-teardown/<brand>/<label>/

files.what: The swipe: its source link, brand and why it was picked

stages.name: Video writing

activates.say: Open the hand-off {key} from {folder} (the door puts teardown-run/ at runs/video-teardown/_work/{label}/), then run the video writing on {label}.

stages.makes: stages 3 to 5 in the teardown working folder; the accepted brief filed at runs/video-writing/<brand>/<label>/deliverable/5-brief.md

files.what: The teardown run's record, stages 0 to 2 done on a route

stages.name: Video production

activates.say: Open the hand-off {key} from {folder}. Read START.md, then BRIEF.md. Run video production on BRIEF.md for {brand}, format {format}: dry run first, then the run, in the Video Studio. Its pack files the editor's hand-off.

stages.makes: runs/video-production/<brand>/<label>/ (voice, stills, clips), then the edit kit: components/video-edit/maker/maker_pack.py files the video-editor hand-off at runs/handoffs/video-editor/<brand>/<brief key>/

files.what: The writing's brief (deliverable/5-brief.md), accepted by its checks
The swipe torn down: every beat production copies
The replication spec: what must carry over

stages.name: Video edit

activates.say: Open brief {number} in hyperframes (or: in premiere), or run the edit line on {folder}.

stages.makes: the finished cut in the hand-off's returned/ (<brief key>-control.mp4) and the approval card in Shared Assets/meta/<brand>/1-check/video/

receives.why: The editor's hand-off is the production's edit kit, built by components/video-edit/maker/maker_pack.py; its checks stay where they were proven (2463ac7b01).

stages.built_by: python3 components/video-edit/maker/maker_pack.py <production> [--productions <dir>] (moved out of the Video Studio 2026-11-17; the Studio's Send to maker calls it)

every_handoff._what: What every hand-off folder carries, whatever the stage. The video-edit stage keeps its own checks instead.

files.what: The hand-off record: chain, stage, role, brand, brief, where it came from, how to switch it on
One page: what this is, the line to say to your Claude, where the work goes next
